The project

A signature of heritage, translated to the web.

A digital storefront for NURA by Bin Sadhik, bringing a curated fragrance collection into an immersive emerald and gold experience.

Website
nura-woad.vercel.app ↗

01 / The brief

A clear purpose.

Give perfume and concentrated perfume oil a shared home while keeping the collection easy to understand. Visitors should be able to explore the character of a fragrance, compare formats, and choose a size.

02 / The approach

Built around the journey.

An atmospheric product-led introduction leads into fragrance discovery. Product details, scent notes, format and size selection, and a shopping bag support a personal ordering conversation on WhatsApp.

04 / Visual direction

One coherent
experience.

Deep green textures, a restrained gold accent, and expressive serif typography reflect the existing NURA identity. Product imagery carries the visual story throughout the site.
